## Teaching points

1. Fever, flank tenderness and pyuria support pyelonephritis rather than isolated cystitis.
2. Pregnancy changes disposition: initial inpatient parenteral treatment and obstetric review are appropriate.
3. Follow renal function, fluid balance and response, then tailor treatment to the culture; a falling temperature alone is not a discharge criterion.
